messages:
evan.arch: Quick follow-up to the RFC: proposing a lightweight 'surface stewardship' model to guide long-term modularization and tech-debt paydown. Posting the short plan + open questions.
jules.eng: curious — what's 'stewardship' mean in practice?
evans.arch: idea: each public surface (route/topic/stream) gets a steward (team lead) responsible for contract stability, migration roadmap, and debt amortization score. stewardship rotates quarterly if needed.
priya.pm: ok but how do we prioritize? product pressure is real.
evans.arch: prioritization heuristic: impact_score = call_rate * consumer_count * user_impact_factor. Surfaces with highest impact_score go into the Q-plan for extraction or stabilization. Also factor in test_coverage and current_sync_ratio as tie-breakers.
marco.sre: operational constraints? we need predictable windows. Can we batch extractions by shared infra changes to reduce proxy toggles?
evans.arch: yes — plan to group small extracts by proxy-surface families so infra changes roll up. Batch size cap: ~6 extracts per batch to keep canaries comprehensible.
jules.eng: metrics to track paydown? i want to see real signals.
evans.arch: minimal dashboard: sync_call_fraction, avg_p95_cross_service, contract_churn_weekly, extracts_in_flight, and blocked_refactor_count. Quarter target: reduce sync_call_fraction by 28% and blocked_refactor_count by 50%.
priya.pm: governance: how do we prevent endless bikeshedding?
evans.arch: propose an approvals flow: steward publishes short proposal (owner, rationale, rollback plan, tests), 3-day review window, then extraction sprint scheduled. If no objections, auto-approve. Emergency objections escalate to arch leads.
marco.sre: failure modes: streaming and sticky sessions need explicit notes — add sticky-routing fallbacks and sticky TTLs to the steward checklist. Also infra needs 3w lead for proxy toggle features.
evans.arch: good call, added sticky-session items and infra lead time to the checklist.
jules.eng: tooling: can we auto-compute impact_score and surface map? that would save time.
evans.arch: infra will expose a surface-mapper job that scans the service registry + traces to compute call rates and consumer counts. infra-bot will post weekly top-50 surfaces for review.
infra-bot: Job scheduled: surface-mapper.weekly (owner: infra, next run: 1759999200).
priya.pm: i'll own the product acceptance tests and coordinate freeze windows. Also will add a 'deploy-avoid' calendar to the stewardship board.
evans.arch: action items: (1) infra: surface-mapper + proxy-toggles lead time (2) eng: steward assignments for Q-plan (3) product: acceptance tile + calendar. tagging folks to confirm in 24h before I publish the Stewardship RFC update.
